cause_quote: The introducing diff passed `model: resolvedModel` to `sessions.create`, turning the automatically selected child model into a user override that disabled configured fallbacks.
user_saw: A visible child spawned without an explicit model choice failed when its primary model was rate-limited, even though a backup was configured.
summary: The fix preserves automatic model selection at visible child creation and uses the child's configured fallback policy on initial and later direct requests.
reasoning: The path history shows this commit introduced visible spawning and passed the automatically resolved model through the explicit model field from the start. I checked the creation and fallback code at that commit and confirmed that a non-default model passed this way was stored with user provenance, causing the runner to use an empty fallback list.
